div.head: III Em 7.2
div.ab: Et prepositus uel tainus, comes uel uillanus, qui hoc facere nolet aut disperdet, emendet CXX sol. et sit dignus eorum que supra dicta sunt.
Et praepositus vel tainus, comes vel villanus, qui hoc facere nolet aut disperdet, emendet CXX sol. et sit dignus eorum quae supra dicta sunt.
And the reeve or the thegn, the noble or commoner who refuses to do this, or disregards it, shall pay a fine of 120 shillings, and incur the penalties which have been stated above.
div.note: IV As 7; II As 25; V As 1.2; V As 1.4

⁊ se gerefa oððe þegn, ge eorl ge ceorl, þe þis don nylle oððe oferhebbe, bete cyninge 120 scil. las Or. laut II As 25. V 1, 2. 4; daraus IV 7. Das hoc bezieht sich auf Verbürgung Bescholtener (in 7), wohl auch die Beihilfe zur Spurfolge (in 6) und vielleicht die Fernhaltung Bescholtener vom Gefolge (in 3)

⁊ se gerefa oððe þegn, ge eorl ge ceorl, þe þis don nylle oððe oferhebbe, bete cyninge 120 scil. was the reading of the original, according to II As 25. V 1, 2. 4; and from this IV 7. The hoc refers to the giving of surety for persons of ill repute (in 7), probably also to assistance in the pursuit of the trail (in 6), and perhaps to keeping persons of ill repute out of the retinue (in 3)
Die Rechtsnachteile, mit denen hier gedroht wird, sind vermutlich Haftung für das Eingeklagte (in 3) und Friedlosigkeit in 2
The legal disadvantages threatened here are presumably liability for the object of the claim (in 3) and outlawry in 2
Cf. IV As. 7; II As. 25; V As. 1, 2.
i.e. ge eorl ge ceorl, cf. Af. 4, 2.
The penalties do not appear to be specified in the code as it has come down to us.
